# Words that name one game, which nothing in this repository may contain outside the
# allowed files (README.md and CLAUDE.md list the game projects by name). One
# case-insensitive regular expression per line; tools/check_generic.py reads it.
#
# Add a game's title, disc ID and its most distinctive nouns when a project for it starts.
